channels.name: 42章经
channels.description:
你好，我是曲凯，42章经的创始人。

小的时候我不太舍得花钱，记得当年一毛钱一袋的牛肉干真的很好吃，但如果偶尔遇到一个很有趣的人，我会欣然花几十、上百块请他吃个饭，还觉得自己赚到了。

后来长大了一些，开始刷人人网、豆瓣、知乎、再到现在的即刻……

你有没有偶尔在这些平台刷到过一个很有缘的人，然后在一个夏日的午后，把他的发言、转载和收藏全都看了一遍，并觉得心有戚戚焉。

再后来工作和创业以后，每天就是聊各种各样的投资人、创业者。

如果能聊到一个优秀的人，真的会有一种如沐春风的感觉，并真心觉得很幸福。

而同行们见面经常会聊到的问题也是：最近有没有遇到什么有意思的人？

所以，这个播客就是要努力把这些人带到你的身边。

我们只专注和有趣、有独到认知、又愿意坦诚分享的聪明人聊天。

希望你听完每一期都能回到小时候，回到那个因为认识了有趣的人、收获了新知，而感到单纯美好幸福的时刻。

如果听完以后，你还能暗自感慨一句，

“我也好想认识这个人啊。”

或者，

“哇靠，有被启发到。”

那这个播客也就值了。

Antarctic explorer Ernest Shackleton would appreciate today's biotech. Scientific entrepreneurs of the 21st century must be ready for what Shackleton called the “hazardous journey, bitter cold, long months of complete darkness, constant danger, safe return doubtful, honor and recognition in case of success.” Today, the men and women who strive to apply science for the betterment of human health have a historic opportunity. channels.name: DNA Today
channels.description:
"DNA Today" is a genetics podcast in the top 1% of podcasts globally and winner of the Best 2020 and 2021 Science and Medicine Podcast Awards. Over the last decade, the show has produced over 200 episodes covering topics like genetic conditions, technology, careers, and news. Host Kira Dineen interviews leaders in genetics including genetic counselors, researchers, doctors and patient advocates.

Kourtney Kardashian featured our host Kira Dineen and the podcast in her recent article on Poosh. With over 40 sponsors, including leaders like Illumina and ThermoFisher, "DNA Today" is valued as a leading voice in genetics.    

"DNA Today" is broadcast every Friday 10:30am EST on WHUS 91.7 FM in Connecticut.

channels.description:
Together with you, we explore a new world!

Zhang Xiaojun Podcast is an in-depth talk show featuring long-form conversations of 2 to 7 hours. It centers on authentic personal expression and high-density cutting-edge information. Produced by Language Is World Studio.

Host Zhang Xiaojun is a financial journalist specializing in in-depth coverage of tech industry, including AI, tech giants, venture capital, and prominent figures. She has won 13 journalism awards at home and abroad, among which she received the SOPA (Society of Publishers in Asia) Award for Excellence in Journalism for three consecutive years from 2022 to 2024 — widely known as the "Pulitzer Prize of Asia." She is also the founder of Language Is World Studio.

"If my interviews can walk with you along a lonely and unknown path, and bring you a little closer to your destination one day, my heart will be filled with warmth." — Zhang Xiaojun
